message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2 allele) in European populations**

| Population | Minor allele (C) frequency | Major allele (T) frequency |
|------------|---------------------------|-----------------------------|
| European (overall, gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 0.07 (7 %)** | ≈ 0.93 (93 %) |
| Non‑Finnish European | ≈ 0.07 (7 %) |
| Finnish | ≈ 0.05 (5 %) |
| British | ≈ 0.07 (7 %) |
| Iberian | ≈ 0.08 (8 %) |
| Italian | ≈ 0.07 (7 %) |

> **Key points**
> 
> * rs7412 is one of two SNPs that define the APOE ε2/ε3/ε4 alleles.  
> * The C allele at rs7412 corresponds to the ε2 allele, which is the minor allele in most European subpopulations.  
> * Frequencies vary slightly among sub‑European groups but generally hover around 5–8 %.  
> * These values come from the gnomAD database (v2.1.1) and the 1000 Genomes Project; they represent allele counts from thousands of individuals.

If you need more granular data (e.g., by country or specific ancestry group) or the most recent updates from gnomAD v3.x, let me know!
